messages.subject: Send Backslash with textInput
parts:
A function I have in my Shiny app requires passing a character symbol that uses backslashes in R. For example, my R program is similar to

myFun <- foo(arg1, arg2 = ' ')

In Shiny, I use textInput for arg2 as this character must allowed to be any possible character the user would need to pass to this function. 

However, using textInput to send ' " actually sends '\n" to the function. Perhaps an easy way to see this is to use the existing example at the link below and type in text into the textInput example.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/widget-gallery.html

Is there a way to enter text into textInput such that it passes *only* ' '?

Thank you

messages.author: 34d1b12964c01466
messages.subject: Re: Send Backslash with textInput
parts:
You might look at gsub()

Something like gsub('\\n', '\n', input$arg2) in order to make arg2 look like you want.
